question:
I have a project where I am using dbt. I have installed dbt core using the command 'pip install dbt-core' I ran the command 'pip install dbt-databricks'

But when I run the dbt --version, I do not see the databricks under the plugin
title: How to install databricks plugin for dbt project
answer:
Make sure python is installed on the system.

In my case I want to install dbt-core version 1.6.0 and I need the compatible databricks adapater to it.

This is the command that I used.

pip install dbt-core==1.6.0 dbt-databricks

then, run dbt--version and make sure it shows the dbt-core as installed and under the adapter section make sure databricks is installed
